title: The Lord tells Elijah to go out and stand on the mountain
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Direct order at Horeb before the wind, earthquake, fire and gentle breeze; no record in 19:9-14.

title: Jezebel’s letters order a fast and seat Naboth before the people
speaker: Jezebel, in letters sealed with Ahab’s seal
recipient: the elders and free men of Jezreel
note: The letter continues in 20:10: suborn two false witnesses and stone Naboth; the title should name this.

title: The Syrian king demands Ahab’s silver, gold, wives and children
speaker: the son of Ader (Ben-hadad), king of Syria, through messengers
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Demand and threat to search the houses (21:5-6) are unrecorded; only Ahab's refusal (21:9) has a record.

title: Orders concerning the district rulers’ attendants during the siege
speaker: the son of Ader (Ben-hadad), king of Syria
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The order 'take them alive, whether for peace or war' (21:18) opens the order recorded at 21:19.

title: The Syrian advisers propose replacing the kings with governors
speaker: the attendants of the king of Syria
note: The counsel runs 21:23-25: fight on level ground and rebuild the lost army horse for horse.

title: Ben-hadad’s envoys in sackcloth beg Ahab to spare his life
speaker: the son of Ader (Ben-hadad), through his attendants
note: Request distinct from the proposal at 21:31 and Ahab's reply at 21:33.

title: Ben-hadad offers terms and Ahab releases him under a treaty
speaker: the son of Ader (Ben-hadad) and Ahab
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Treaty terms: cities restored and markets in Damascus; condemned by the prophet at 21:42.

title: A prophet, by the Lord’s word, asks his companions to strike him
speaker: one of the sons of the prophets, by the Lord's word
note: The man who refuses is killed by a lion for not listening to the Lord's voice (21:36).

title: Jehoshaphat asks Ahab to inquire of the Lord first
speaker: Jehoshaphat king of Judah
note: Parallel 2 Chronicles 18:4 is also unrecorded.

title: The messenger urges Micaiah to speak favourably like the other prophets
speaker: the messenger sent to call Micaiah
note: Parallel 2 Chronicles 18:12 is also unrecorded.

title: Ahab adjures Micaiah to speak only the truth in the Lord’s name
speaker: Ahab king of Israel
note: An adjuration framed as a question; parallel 2 Chronicles 18:15 is also unrecorded.

title: Micaiah recounts a spirit being permitted to deceive Ahab’s prophets
speaker: the Lord, as recounted by Micaiah
recipient: the spirit before the Lord's throne
note: Micaiah's 'Hear the Lord's word' and the Lord's call 'Who will deceive Ahab?' (22:20) begin the commission.

title: Syria’s king orders his chariots to target only Israel’s king
speaker: the king of Syria
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Kings parallel of 2 Chronicles 18:30.

title: The army herald sends every man home after Ahab’s death
speaker: the army herald
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list.

title: Ahaziah sends messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub
speaker: Ahaziah; the Lord's angel to Elijah
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The grouped record includes the angel's charge to Elijah (1:3); that charge continues in 1:4, ending 'Elijah went and spoke to them.'

title: The third captain begs Elijah to spare his life and his men
speaker: the third captain of fifty
note: Contrasts with the captains' demands recorded at 1:9 and 1:11.

title: Elijah asks Elisha to stay behind at each stage of the journey
speaker: Elijah
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Three requests (Bethel, Jericho, Jordan), each refused with Elisha's oath.

title: Elisha tells the sons of the prophets to keep silent
speaker: Elisha
recipient: the sons of the prophets at Bethel and Jericho
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life

title: The prophets press Elisha to let them search for Elijah
speaker: Elisha
note: Elisha's reproach 'Did I not tell you, Do not go?' recalls his prohibition after the failed search.

title: Jehoram asks Jehoshaphat to join his campaign against Moab
speaker: Jehoram king of Israel
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Alliance request in question form, with the route agreed; similar requests at 1 Kings 22:4 and 2 Chronicles 18:3 are unrecorded.

title: Elisha calls for a musician and gives the Lord’s instruction to dig pits
speaker: the Lord through Elisha
recipient: the kings of Israel, Judah and Edom
note: The oracle continues: strike fortified cities, fell good trees, stop springs, spoil fields (3:19; carried out 3:25).

title: The Shunammite proposes building and furnishing a room for Elisha
speaker: the Shunammite woman
note: Hospitality to the man of God: room with bed, table, stool and lampstand.

title: Elisha sends Gehazi to ask the Shunammite what favour she wants
speaker: Elisha

title: The Shunammite asks her husband for a servant and donkey
speaker: the Shunammite woman
note: Request to reach the man of God after her son's death; distinct from her order to the attendant (4:24).

title: Elisha sends Gehazi running to ask after the Shunammite’s family
speaker: Elisha

title: The Shunammite recalls her plea not to be deceived
speaker: the Shunammite woman
note: She repeats her earlier plea (4:16) as a reproach.

title: Syria’s king sends Naaman to Israel with a letter
speaker: the king of Syria
recipient: Naaman, and by letter the king of Israel
note: The letter's demand that Israel's king cure Naaman (5:6) completes the sending.

title: Elisha asks Israel’s king to send Naaman to him
speaker: Elisha
note: 'Let him know that there is a prophet in Israel.'

title: Naaman’s servants urge him to bathe as the prophet said
speaker: Naaman's attendants
note: Counsel that turns Naaman back to obey Elisha's word (5:14).

title: Naaman asks for Israelite earth and pardon to worship the Lord
speaker: Naaman
note: Two mule-loads of earth to sacrifice to the Lord alone; pardon for bowing in Remman's house.

title: Gehazi falsely asks Naaman for silver and robes in Elisha’s name
speaker: Gehazi
note: Lying request punished with leprosy (5:26-27); the gift itself is only a Study Context record (5:23).

title: The prophets ask Elisha to let them build by the Jordan
speaker: the sons of the prophets
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Their further request 'Please come with your slaves' (6:3) belongs to the same exchange.

title: A woman recounts a desperate bargain made during the famine
speaker: a woman of besieged Samaria
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Her account and the second demand 'Give your son' continue in 6:29.

title: An attendant proposes sending horsemen to scout the abandoned camp
speaker: one of the king's attendants
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Proposal acted on by the king's commission at 7:14.

title: The king asks Gehazi to recount Elisha’s great deeds
speaker: the king of Israel
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Request for an account; leads to the restoration ordered at 8:6.

title: Elisha tells the young prophet to take Jehu aside privately
speaker: Elisha
recipient: one of the sons of the prophets
note: The instruction begins in 9:1: fasten your belt, take the flask of oil, go to Ramoth-gilead.

title: The prophetic messenger anoints Jehu and charges him to avenge the slain prophets
speaker: the Lord through the young prophet
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The oracle ends at 9:10 (Jezebel's fate), and the prophet flees as Elisha instructed (9:3).

title: Jehu’s fellow officers press him to tell what the prophet said
speaker: the commanders with Jehu
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Request that leads to Jehu's acclamation as king (9:13).

title: Jehu orders that no one slip out to warn Jezreel
speaker: Jehu
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life

title: Joram orders his chariot yoked to go and meet Jehu
speaker: Joram king of Israel
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list.

title: Jehu tells his officer to throw Joram’s body into Naboth’s field
speaker: Jehu
note: The order is completed in 9:26: 'lift him up and throw him into the portion, according to the Lord's word.'

title: Jehu orders Jezebel buried because she is a king’s daughter
speaker: Jehu
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life

title: Jehu calls to the officials at Jezebel’s window
speaker: Jehu
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list: the order itself, 'Roll her down!', is in 9:33.

title: Jehu’s letter dares Samaria’s leaders to crown Ahab’s son and fight
speaker: Jehu, by letter
recipient: the rulers, elders and guardians in Samaria
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life

title: Jehu’s second letter orders the heads of Ahab’s seventy sons
speaker: Jehu, by letter
recipient: the rulers, elders and guardians in Samaria
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Order carried out in 10:7; the piling of the heads (10:8) is recorded separately.

title: Jehu invites Jonadab to witness his zeal
speaker: Jehu
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 'If it is, give me your hand' (10:15) begins the same invitation.

title: Jehu summons Baal’s worshipers under false pretenses
speaker: Jehu
recipient: all Baal's servants, priests and prophets throughout Israel
note: The summons is sent throughout Israel with its threat in 10:21.

title: Jehu orders his men to kill the assembled worshipers of Baal
speaker: Jehu
recipient: the eighty men posted outside, his runners and officers
note: 10:24 posts the eighty men under penalty of life for any who escape.

title: Jehoiada limits temple entry and stations armed Levites around the king
speaker: Jehoiada the priest
recipient: the captains of hundreds and their divisions
note: Kings parallel: surround the king, weapons in hand; whoever enters the ranks dies.

title: Jehoiada crowns and anoints the boy Joash as king
speaker: Jehoiada the priest
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list. AUD-14-23-3 records only Jehoiada's call; parallel 2 Chronicles 23:11 is also unrecorded.

title: Jehoiada covenants king and people to be the Lord’s people
speaker: Jehoiada the priest
note: Covenant between the Lord, king and people; parallel 2 Chronicles 23:16 is also unrecorded.

title: Joash directs the priests to use the silver to repair the temple
speaker: Joash king of Judah
note: Outside candidate list: the order begins in 12:5 by naming the silver to be received.

title: Joash answers Amaziah with the story of the thornbush and cedar
speaker: Joash king of Israel
note: The fable's application follows in 14:10: enjoy your glory at home; why court disaster?

title: Ahaz sends Uriah the Damascus altar’s design to copy
speaker: King Ahaz
note: Outside candidate list. Reported building instruction carried out exactly (16:11); precedes the order recorded at 16:15.

title: Israel is warned against following the other nations’ customs
speaker: the Lord, as recalled by the narrator
note: Recalls the command not to act like the surrounding nations.

title: Israel is warned to remember the covenant and reject other gods
speaker: the Lord, as recalled by the narrator
note: The positive counterpart follows in 17:39: fear the Lord your God, and He will rescue you.

title: Hezekiah asks Sennacherib to withdraw and accepts a heavy tribute
speaker: Hezekiah king of Judah, through messengers
recipient: Sennacherib king of Assyria at Lachish
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 'Withdraw from me; whatever you impose I will bear'; Assyria imposes 300 talents of silver and 30 of gold.

title: Hezekiah commands Judah to worship only before the Jerusalem altar
speaker: Hezekiah, as quoted by the Assyrian envoy
note: Recalled royal decree centralising worship; parallels Isaiah 36:7 and 2 Chronicles 32:12 are also unrecorded.

title: The Assyrian envoy dares Judah to wager horses with Assyria
speaker: Rabshakeh (Rhapsakes), the Assyrian envoy
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Taunting proposal; parallel Isaiah 36:8 is also unrecorded.

title: The Assyrian envoy tells Jerusalem not to trust Hezekiah
speaker: Rabshakeh (Rhapsakes)
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: His summons 'Hear the words of the great king' (18:28) opens the warning.

title: The Assyrian envoy compares the Lord with gods that failed to save
speaker: Rabshakeh (Rhapsakes)
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Kings parallel of Isaiah 36:18-20, which is recorded under ot-isaiah-v36-18.

title: Hezekiah asks Isaiah to pray for the remnant
speaker: Hezekiah, through Eliakim, Shebna and the elder priests
note: Hezekiah's message to Isaiah begins in 19:3.

title: The Lord sends Isaiah back with a promise to heal Hezekiah
speaker: the Lord
note: The message continues in 20:6 (fifteen added years, rescue of the city), as in the Isaiah 38:5 record.

title: Hezekiah asks for a sign and chooses the shadow’s return
speaker: Hezekiah king of Judah
note: Request addressed to Isaiah, not a prayer; parallel Isaiah 38:22 is also unrecorded.

title: Israel is charged to keep the written law and fear no other gods
speaker: the Lord, as recalled by the narrator
note: Recalled divine word: Israel stays in the land if it keeps the whole law Moses commanded.

title: Josiah asks his officials to seek the Lord about the recovered book
speaker: King Josiah
recipient: Hilkiah, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan and Asaiah
note: Outside candidate list: 22:12 introduces the order ('The king commanded...').

title: Huldah directs the officials to relay the Lord’s answer to Josiah
speaker: the Lord through Huldah the prophetess
note: The answer runs to 22:20, with a second 'say this' to the king at 22:18.

title: Josiah and the people covenant to keep the Lord’s commandments
speaker: King Josiah
recipient: the people of Judah and Jerusalem
note: Covenant to follow the Lord and keep the book's words; parallel 2 Chronicles 34:31-32 is also unrecorded.

title: Josiah orders the priests to remove Baal’s vessels from the temple
speaker: King Josiah
recipient: Hilkiah the high priest, the second priests and the doorkeepers
note: Outside candidate list: explicit reported order opening Josiah's reform.

title: Nebuchadnezzar appoints Gedaliah over the people left in Judah
speaker: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; Gedaliah's own counsel (25:24) is already recorded.

title: David appoints Levites over the singing before the tent
speaker: King David
recipient: the Levitical singers (Heman, Asaph, Ethan and their kin)
note: Outside candidate list (6:16 was context). Reported appointment of singers; chapter has no records.

title: David and Samuel appoint the gatekeepers to their trusted office
speaker: David and Samuel the seer
note: Reported appointment of Levites to guard the gates of the Lord's house.

title: David promises command to whoever first strikes the Jebusites
speaker: David
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Joab goes up first and becomes chief; parallel 2 Samuel 5:8 is also unrecorded.

title: Israel’s elders anoint David king at Hebron by covenant
speaker: the elders of Israel
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list. AUD-10-5-2 records God's appointment (11:2); parallel 2 Samuel 5:3 is also unrecorded.

title: David longs for water from Bethlehem’s well and pours it out
speaker: David
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Wish taken as a request by the three; parallel 2 Samuel 23:15-17 is also unrecorded.

title: David appoints Benaiah over his house for his exploits
speaker: David
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Reported appointment; parallel 2 Samuel 23:23 is also unrecorded.

title: David proposes bringing the ark back among the people
speaker: David
note: The proposal begins in 13:2: send for the brethren, priests and Levites to gather.

title: David has the Levite chiefs appoint singers and musicians for the ark
speaker: David
note: Order (15:16) and the appointments made under it (15:17-24); not covered by 15:12-15.

title: David rules that only the Levites may carry God’s ark
speaker: David
note: Outside candidate list. Royal ruling restating Deuteronomy 10:8 (AUD-05-10-8).

title: The people are to answer Amen and praise the Lord
speaker: David's psalm of thanksgiving
note: Liturgical response after the doxology; Greek Psalm 105:48 parallel is also unrecorded.

title: David leaves Asaph at the ark and Zadok’s priests at Gibeon
speaker: David
recipient: Asaph, Obed-edom and the gatekeepers; Zadok and the priests; Heman and Jeduthun
note: Continual ministry at both sites, burnt offerings 'as written in the Lord's law'; AUD-13-16-4 covers only 16:4-7.

title: The Lord designates David’s son to build his house
speaker: the Lord through Nathan
note: Original designation behind 22:10 and 28:6, already linked to this record.

title: Joab urges courage in defending their people and cities
speaker: Joab
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The mutual-rescue arrangement (19:12) opens the same charge.

title: Gad tells David to build an altar at Orna’s threshing floor
speaker: the Lord's angel through Gad
note: Chronicles parallel of 2 Samuel 24:18.

title: David asks to purchase Orna’s threshing floor for an altar
speaker: David
note: Outside candidate list: David insists on full price, refusing a costless offering (21:24).

title: David conscripts resident foreigners as stonecutters for the temple
speaker: David
note: Reported order and appointment of quarrymen.

title: David charges Solomon to build the house for the Lord
speaker: David
note: Reported charge ('commanded him to build'); 22:10 is already linked here.

title: David urges Solomon to keep Moses’ ordinances and take courage
speaker: David
note: 22:11-12 open the charge: build the house, and may the Lord give you wisdom to keep his law.

title: David calls Israel’s leaders to seek the Lord and build the sanctuary
speaker: David
note: 22:17 reports the command to support Solomon that the speech (22:18-19) delivers.

title: David appoints Solomon to reign over Israel and Judah
speaker: David
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list: 'he made Solomon his son king in his place.'

title: David numbers the Levites, assigns their offices and divides them
speaker: David
note: Outside candidate list: supervisors, scribes and judges, gatekeepers, musicians; courses by Levi's sons.

title: David assigns Levites as officers and judges for outside duties
speaker: King David
note: Covers P00988 (26:32): appointed 'for every ordinance of the Lord and word of the king.'

title: David, Zadok and Ahimelech divide the priests by lot into courses
speaker: David, with Zadok and Ahimelech
note: Outside candidate list: twenty-four courses, 'according to their ordinance through Aaron, as the Lord commanded' (24:19).

title: David appoints the families of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun as temple singers
speaker: King David and the army commanders
recipient: the sons of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun
note: Outside candidate list: singers set apart to prophesy with instruments; duties assigned by lot (25:8).

title: The gatekeepers’ divisions receive their gates by lot
speaker: David's arrangement for the Levites
note: Outside candidate list: duty stations assigned by lot, as for priests (24:5) and singers (25:8).

title: David declares the Lord chose Solomon to sit on Israel’s throne
speaker: the Lord, as declared by David
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Throne designation; 28:6 (temple builder) is already linked to ot-1-chronicles-v28-10.

title: David gives Solomon the Lord-given written pattern for the temple
speaker: David, from the Lord's hand
note: Outside candidate list: plan of courts, chambers, courses, vessels by weight, cherubim chariot (28:19).

title: David appeals to the assembly to give willingly for the temple
speaker: King David
note: 'Who is eager to fill his hands today for the Lord?' (29:5); answered by freewill gifts (29:6-9).

title: Israel anoints Solomon king again and Zadok as priest
speaker: the assembly of Israel
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list: anointing 'for the Lord' as king and for the priesthood.

title: Hiram sends the skilled craftsman Huram-abi to work for Solomon
speaker: Hiram (Chiram) king of Tyre
note: Answer to Solomon's request (2:6-7); the craftsman is to work with Solomon's and David's skilled men.

title: Hiram requests the provisions Solomon promised his workers
speaker: Hiram (Chiram) king of Tyre
note: The letter's terms continue in 2:15: timber rafted to Joppa, 'You shall bring it to Jerusalem.'

title: Solomon asks Hiram for a skilled artisan and timber from Lebanon
speaker: Solomon
note: Outside candidate list: the letter opens at 2:2 and its terms (joint crews, provisions) run to 2:9.

title: Solomon conscripts resident foreigners as porters, quarrymen and overseers
speaker: Solomon
note: Outside candidate list (2:16 was context); see also 2:1. Compare David's levy, 1 Chronicles 22:2.

title: Solomon recounts God appointing David’s son to build the temple
speaker: the Lord, as recounted by Solomon
note: Chronicles parallel of 1 Kings 8:18-20; 6:10 reports its fulfilment.

title: Humble yourselves, pray and turn, and the Lord will heal the land
speaker: the Lord
note: Conditional promise that directs repentance; compare Wisdom record AUD-14-15-1. No record in 2 Chronicles 7.

title: The Lord had commanded Solomon to reject other gods
speaker: the Lord
note: Chronicles parallel of 1 Kings 9:4-9, already linked to this record.

title: Solomon rules his Egyptian wife may not live in David’s city
speaker: Solomon
note: Ruling grounded in the holiness of places the ark entered.

title: Solomon stations the priestly and Levitical divisions as David commanded
speaker: Solomon, following David's ordinance
note: Outside candidate list: courses, watches and gates assigned; 'they did not transgress the king's commands' (8:15).

title: Happy are those who stand near wisdom and keep hearing it
speaker: the queen of Sheba
note: Beatitude in praise of Solomon's servants; parallel 1 Kings 10:8 is also unrecorded.

summary: 109 findings (65 new, 32 extend, 12 parallel): unrecorded kings' orders, prophets' requests, covenants, and Chronicles appointments of priests, Levites and singers; 23 lie outside the candidate list.
